Gives the address of each link as the page wrote it, beside the resolved address

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineObj = try createEngine(config: nil)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.links().count)
debugPrint(result.links()[0].originalUrl())
debugPrint(result.links()[0].url())
```
